# cloady_variable (Resource)

Manages one app environment variable. Values are marked sensitive but are stored in Terraform state. Changes take effect on the next app deployment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Stored setting; takes effect at the next deployment. Use cloady_app.values
# instead when Terraform should deploy the change as part of the same apply.
resource "cloady_variable" "database_url" {
  workspace = cloady_workspace.acme.slug
  app       = cloady_app.api.slug
  region    = cloady_app.api.region
  key       = "DATABASE_URL"
  value     = var.database_url
  is_secret = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) App slug.
- `key` (String) Environment variable name, in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE (at most 80 characters).
- `region` (String) Region ID of the app instance.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Variable value, at most 4096 characters. Stored in Terraform state even when is_secret is true.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace slug.

### Optional

- `environment` (String) App environment: production, preview, or development. Defaults to production.
- `is_secret` (Boolean) Encrypt the value at rest in Cloady. Defaults to false. Terraform state still contains the plaintext value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import identity: workspace/app/environment/region/variable_id.
- `variable_id` (String) Variable ID returned by the API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# workspace/app/environment/region/variable-uuid
terraform import cloady_variable.database_url acme/api/production/eu1/e25ffcac-b57d-46a0-9614-bbe3a1d18eaa
```
